name: Leo V of Armenia
contribution: The last Latin king of the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia.
legacy: This person, of the House of Lusignan, was the last Latin king of the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia.

checks.lead: Leo V or Levon V (occasionally Levon VI; Armenian: Լեւոն, Levon V; 1342 – 29 November 1393), of the House of Lusignan, was the last Latin king of the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia. Leo was described as "Leo V, King of Armenia" on his own personal seal (Sigilum Leonis Quinti Regis Armenie), and as "Leo of Lusignan the Fifth" in the Middle French inscription on his cenotaph: Leon de Lizingnen quint.
